about: ErrorPage — the page that says a page is missing, the service is broken or the service is closed, and what to do. Inside the site's usual header and footer, without breadcrumbs: the heading in plain w

kind.about: not-found (404), problem (500, any unexpected problem), unavailable (503: closed, for now or for good).

title.about: The heading. Each kind's words are the tested ones: change them only with content sign-off.

children.about: In place of each kind's own words, for the body.

availableFrom.about: When an unavailable service is back, as a day, date and time: "9am on Monday 3 November 2026".

answers.about: What happened to what they entered: "We saved your answers. They will be available for 30 days."

contact.about: How to get help: a link to a page with numbers and opening times, or those details (ContactDetails).

alternative.about: Another service they can use instead.

action.about: One way on, when there is one: "Go to the homepage".

search.about: A search box, only when the header has none.

serviceName.about: Sets the document title to "[heading] – [service name]", so a screen reader hears what happened with the page.

focusOnShow.about: Move focus to the heading when shown (an app that changes route without loading a page).
